lines.text: In the seventh year, elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, but He said He would not be consulted.
God made Himself known to Israel in Egypt, but they kept the idols of Egypt, so He brought them into the wilderness.
Israel profaned His Sabbaths in the wilderness, yet God looked on them with pity and did not destroy them.
God swore to scatter the children among the nations, and in the land they sacrificed on any high hill or under any leafy tree, at a place called Bethel.
God said all Israel would serve Him on the rivers of Babylon, and He would accept them as a pleasing aroma.
